comment: vida-eval regression set. Grading is case-insensitive substring matching. must_mention: ALL must appear in the turn's final answer. must_not_say: NONE may appear. tool_must_not_contain: NONE may appear in any tool-call argument string for that turn (catches retrieval-layer contamination even when the answer looks clean). Expectations come from ground truth verified against the store during phase-1 acceptance (see docs/handoff.md).

cases.comment: Loop-discipline probe (the 2026-06-13 ~60-turn runaway). Compound part+procedure question where 'cam seal' is NOT an EPC catalogue name (Volvo files it as 'Sealing ring'), so epc_part component search misses and a weak model thrashes. A good model makes a bounded number of tool calls and writes a grounded partial answer. The must_not_say guards CONVERGENCE: if the native harness returns its '(no answer: tool-loop limit reached)' sentinel, this case FAILS. Used as the primary discriminator in the model bake-off.
